text:
sam: FYI discovered a small crash path in embedder when token list is empty causing sporadic 5xx for short inputs (~3% of requests). I have a one-line guard and unit test. Looking to ship a micro hotfix in the 03:30-04:30 UTC change window. Need expedited approvals.

elaine: can you post the exact image tag and rollback command? Also confirm no schema/model bumps.

sam: image: `embedder:hotfix-2026-04-02-guard`. No schema/model changes. Revert: `kubectl set image deploy/embedder embedder=embedder:2026.03.29-prev`

ops-oncall: I'll stand by. If canary error >1% for two 5m windows i'll trigger rollback. What's rollout policy?

sam: rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% over ~25m, with 2m checks between each step.

release-manager: post short internal note for release log and we'll approve once ops + eng lead sign. Approvers required: release-manager, ops-oncall, one eng lead.

maria: short blurb for release: "Fix: guard empty-token path in token-mapper to prevent embedding 5xx on short inputs."

elaine: approve — I reviewed diffs and smoke tests.

ops-oncall: approve. I'll monitor `embedder.errors` and `frontend.5xx_rate` during rollout.

deploybot: Approval set complete. Scheduling deploy at 03:35 UTC. Deployment id `deploy-1759991234-x3`.

sam: pushing image and triggering deploybot now. Posting digest when ready.

sam: image pushed sha256:aa11bb22cc33. deploybot triggered.

deploybot: Canary started at 03:35 UTC (5%). Notifying SLOs and alerting on `embedder.errors`.

ops-oncall: 1st check: errors 0.2%, latency unchanged. advancing to 25%.

release-manager: noted. marking for 24h watch.

deploybot: Rollout reached 100% at 03:58 UTC. No rollback needed. Closing deployment.

sam: thanks team, tagging thread `deploy-1759991234` for post-deploy follow-up.
